attestations.note: doxologia.ro's page for him (https://doxologia.ro/sfantul-kuksa-din-odessa) carries neither a Viață tab nor a Tropar tab, so the calendar's line is the whole of what the Romanian source prints. The day is 22 octombrie, not the 16 septembrie ст. ст. the Russian row holds, and doxologia gives no reason for the difference. Read 24 September 2026.
